test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.

I wonder if the committee members changed________plans.
solution:
The correct answer is '**their**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** homonym for the given blank is '**their**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**their**' is '**of or belonging to them**'.
 
• Hence, the appropriate answer is '**their**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **They're**- 'They're' is a contraction that means "they are."
 
• **Dare**- to have enough courage to do something
 
• **There**- used as the subject of ‘be’, ‘seem’, ‘appear’, etc. to say that something exists.
